what: A photo floats outside the upper right of the phone (frame), tilted 7° (at 17% of its own size, −210% position), and while the section scrolls up off screen it flies down into place inside the frame, shrinking to 0.61x and straightening — from when the section top edge passes 10% of the section height until it rises a further 60% of the section height, tied to scroll with inOutQuad

options.x: Initial horizontal offset (% of own width), default 17
options.y: Initial vertical offset (% of own height), default -210
options.start: Top offset where progress starts (ratio of section height), default .1
options.span: Progress length (ratio of section height), default .6

use: Photo

from.where: index.html .dt-carousel — original Carousel section Carousel__coverImage (translate(17%,−210%) rotate(7deg) scale(1) → 0·0·0·.61, (height×.1 − top)/(height×.6), inOutQuad)
